cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.
